prior.note: Uniform prior; sensitivity grid varies it (see prior_grid).

beta.observation_unit: One admitted independent unit contributes one Bernoulli trial with the oracle truth label as outcome. Correlated copies NEVER become independent trials.
beta.positive_outcome: Admitted unit whose oracle label is supporting.
beta.negative_outcome: Admitted unit whose oracle label is refuting, or any rejected unit presented as support.
beta.weighting: Unweighted trials. No publisher weights in the calibration core.

planning_threshold.note: Remains a hypothesis without suitable data; reported as assumption unless measured.

beta.tail_definition: Regularized incomplete beta I_x(a,b) with x=0.9; posterior Beta(a0+s, b0+f).
beta.numeric_guards: Finite floats only; NaN/Infinity/overflow rejected; zero trials abstains (no posterior); invalid params (non-integer or negative counts, x outside [0,1]) rejected.

reference_values.note: Independently computed by finite binomial summation P[theta>x] = 1 - sum_{j=a}^{a+b-1} C(a+b-1,j) x^j (1-x)^{a+b-1-j} (exact for integer a,b), NOT by the runner's continued-fraction implementation. Values verified 2026-09-04 before freeze.

eigentrust.normalization: Row-stochastic trust matrix (rows sum to 1; zero rows fall back to uniform over pre-trusted set, or abstain when anchorless).
eigentrust.anchor: Fixed pre-trusted set declared per run; trust vector initialized on the anchor distribution.
eigentrust.convergence: Power iteration to L1 delta < 1e-9 or 1000 iterations, whichever first; non-convergence abstains.
eigentrust.disconnected_anchorless: No anchor and no path from any anchor means no trust: output is abstain/flagged-recommendation, never substituted cluster self-trust.

correlation_cap.note: Frozen cap for the calibration core; sensitivity varies it (see rubric).

reputation_baseline.name: reputation-only
reputation_baseline.description: Ranks by raw score with no independence, provenance or policy checks. Expected to fail hard gates; included to prove the gates bite.

result_level: Corpus/model-level result only. No empirically validated production threshold is claimed.
